name: kimi-desktop-personal-agent
description: Kimi desktop personal agent — voice-first home, self-evolving workbench, ACP client for kimi-code CLI
author: AlbertYang

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/ball/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/ball/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/chat/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/chat/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/workbench/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/workbench/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/home/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/home/index.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/ball/index.html src/renderer/ball/style.css dist/renderer/ball/ && cp src/renderer/chat/index.html src/renderer/chat/style.css dist/renderer/chat/ && cp src/renderer/workbench/index.html src/renderer/workbench/style.css dist/renderer/workbench/ && cp src/renderer/home/index.html dist/renderer/home/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/preview dist/renderer/focus-pill && cp src/renderer/preview/index.html dist/renderer/preview/ && cp src/renderer/focus-pill/index.html dist/renderer/focus-pill/ && esbuild src/renderer/todo-panel/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/todo-panel/index.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/todo-panel/index.html dist/renderer/todo-panel/
